description: Ministry of Sports - Order is amended by adding the following new sport/sport class to the end of schedule ii of the Order made under Section 28 of the Sports Act. No. 25 of 1973 published Gaz. Ex. No. 1990/23 of 27.10.2016 (64 uni fight)
